facts.fact: Acclime reports that the Data Protection Office of Mauritius issued updated guidance in September 2026 requiring registration with the Data Protection Commissioner.
Acclime reports that the Data Protection Act 2017 is applied by the Data Protection Office in guidance issued in September 2026.
Acclime reports the Data Protection Office and its Commissioner took registrations and issued guidance in September 2026.
Acclime cites the Data Protection (Designation, Tasks and Position of Data Protection Officers) Regulations 2026 and the Data Protection (Fees) Regulations 2020 under the Act.
Acclime reports guidance requiring Management Companies to register and appoint Data Protection Officers, with no named decision.
Acclime reports the Data Protection Act 2017 and the 2026 Data Protection Officers Regulations are applied in the Office's September 2026 guidance.
Acclime reports the Data Protection Office issued the guidance and registers controllers with the Commissioner.
Acclime reports the Office issued registration and Data Protection Officer guidance and may make site visits.
